summary: Lane client does not pass round 1, because of one regression. The Practice setup screen now offers BRIDGE as a map (src/ui/screens/practice.tsx:25 and :64 list every two-team mode that ends at a core). Picking it starts a match that never loads. I reproduced this live on the real Chrome GPU (_harness/_reports/integ2_client_ver1_practice.json, practice_bridge): the loading bar sat at BRIDGE · Practice for 121 s, with an uncaught page error "rules: queue 'practice' belongs to mode 'rift', not 'bridge'". The client's own recovery (state.ts matchFailed) cannot fire. The bots factory throws at src/session/local_session.ts:526, which is outside the session's try, so no 'match: …' error is ever emitted and the session stays in 'loading'. The root cause is in systems files, and the engineers handed it off correctly (twice). Still, the lane shipped a new UI path that hangs the game, and it could have gated the option in its own file. All other items re-measure as claimed in the current tree, which matches origin at b730f477. client-icons-blood (the one major) passes. I viewed all 18 new item icons at 200, 40 and 38 px myself (_harness/_shots/integ2_client_ver1_icons18_*). Re-measured dark red: lampblack_edge 0.0 %, shadowpin 0.3 %, dawnspur 0.1 %. The remaining hits are ground showing through enclosed gaps: quarry_pick 20.7 %, between pick and haft, and hourstring 6.7 %. resin_maul's red-brown bands and amber drip were accepted earlier. The overlay (_harness/_shots/integ2_client_ver1_darkred18_overlay.png) confirms none of these reads as blood. The six repainted setup and buff icons fit their family and carry no sensitivity issue. Gates: typecheck exit 0; strict content:check OK with 0 warnings. icon_probe OK: p50 min 66 / p95 min 192, navy 0, borrowed [], missing none. sweep_720 fast reports no failures, including draft 1280/1920_lot and both finalize sizes. e2e all PASS 7/7: flow_dodge, flow_readycheck, flow_netdown, rift, bridge, fray, store. The RIFT shop tags end in Dialwood, the nod is recorded, and the wallet goes 300 + 479 = 779 before the skin is bought. e2e store alone (the short path) PASS: CTA '300 more Candles needed', top-up 300 with ledgerSum 600, bought, wallet 0. probe_session_flows 72/72, probe_sim_practice 39/39, probe_content_build 126/126, probe_content_ids 0 hits. Live probes: the BRIDGE Lot at 1280x720 shows no Draw again and '1 take left', then 'No takes left' with all three Take buttons disabled, and 'Ervet went back to the gorge.'. The shop detail shows 'Hour 2 on the dial' plus the 3-hour rule. Practice teleport moved the fighter 5 times out of 5. The damage readout showed 45/89/89/89/89 and dropped to dashes after Clear. Health 2500 and Resist 45 reached the sim's dummy stats. client-1b-14 is not done (the fix is in src/session/profile_store.ts, a systems file; handoff valid). client-r2-07 and client-1b-16 are partly done, both because of the BRIDGE practice crash. Minors are listed per item.

items.evidence: I looked at all 18 at 200 px (_harness/_shots/integ2_client_ver1_icons18_200px.png) and at 40 and 38 px (_harness/_shots/integ2_client_ver1_icons18_40_38px.png). No icon has a red drip or a wound read. lampblack_edge is a clean steel knife and shadowpin is a pin in a pale stone with a violet shadow. I see no hoods, masks, faces, gears, clock hands, gems or runes. The re-run of _harness/_reports/integ_client_r1_darkred.py is in _harness/_reports/integ2_client_ver1_darkred18.txt: lampblack_edge 0.0 %, shadowpin 0.3 %, dawnspur 0.1 % of silhouette, and 0.0 to 0.9 % for every other icon except quarry_pick 20.7 %, resin_maul 7.1 % and hourstring 6.7 %. In _harness/_shots/integ2_client_ver1_darkred18_overlay.png the quarry_pick and hourstring hits are Strike-red ground inside enclosed gaps (between pick and haft, string and stock), and resin_maul's are the red-brown bands. Its drip is honey-amber, not red. Commit 69c4cd07 (dawnspur re-grade) is on origin. icon_probe: _harness/_reports/integ2_client_ver1_icon_probe.json OK.

All required strings are in content/strings.en.json, worded as the plan asks: lot.prompt, lot.lot_note ({s} from bench.fade 8), error.draft.no_swaps, lot.take_left / _plural / take_none, lot.burned, announce.shop_denied.access_bridge, and the longer announce.shop_denied.unique. The client.json:79 BRIDGE Lot tip is replaced. draft.tsx:410-427: canDraw = bench.rerolls > 0, takes come from DraftSeat.swaps, and Take is disabled with the reason. Live, from my probe _harness/_reports/integ2_client_ver1_lot_probe.mjs on bridge_standard at 1280x720 (_harness/_reports/integ2_client_ver1_lot_1280.json; shots _harness/_shots/integ2_client_ver1_lot_1280_0[1-4]_*.png): drawAgain false, '1 take left', then 'No takes left' with 3/3 Take buttons disabled. The ticker read 'twomark_tess took Odrum from the Lot and left Dunsom there.' and then 'Ervet went back to the gorge.'. No clipped text and nothing below the fold. Dial hour: the shop detail for Sunstring read 'Hour 2 on the dial' with a .dialmark (a ring and a pip, no hand), the rule line read 'No other item on the dial may stand within 3 hours of it.', and the tile carries the mark. The client quote in shop.tsx:44-86 mirrors sim/shop.ts quoteBuy: fold, dial clash with the max apart, and the denial order access/slots/unique/gold. Six repaints viewed in _harness/_shots/integ2_client_ver1_six_repaints.png and _setup_icons_all.png: on-family navy ground, glint_step's violet shadow patch, saplight's pool, hourstrike's lit beast print, glass_pane's ring, clearglass on the sunlit half and resinburn on the shadowed half. No sensitivity issue. Minors: (1) lot.swap_done ('You took …') is defined but unused (grep src/ui finds nothing), so after your own take the ticker names you in the third person by your player name (draft.tsx:166-167 Ticker). (2) A Take tooltip opened before the take keeps the enabled hint ('Your fighter goes to the Lot…') after the button turns disabled, until you hover it again (shot _02_taken).
items.fixHint: Optional polish: in Ticker, when took[1] is your own seat's name, use lot.swap_done; re-key the Button tip on disabled so an open tip swaps to the reason.

The UI half works on RIFT. My e2e practice run (_harness/_reports/integ2_client_ver1_practice.json) passed setup with maps [RIFT, BRIDGE], a Veteran Ardit sparring partner on team 1, and tools: Wicks and Structures switched to false, armor 120, targets 3 -> 0 -> 1, aria-pressed matching the sim. Teleport: the e2e step failed in my run (the first ground click did not land, and the retry loop looks for 'Move to a point' while the button reads 'Click the ground…'). My own probe (_harness/_reports/integ2_client_ver1_tp_probe.json) then moved the fighter 2.5 / 4.2 / 5.2 / 4.0 / 7.2 m on five distinct clicks. Every click landed on div.hudsurface and disarmed, so this is a harness race, not a UI bug. Meter probe (_harness/_reports/integ2_client_ver1_meter.json): Health 2500 and Resist 45 reached view.practice.dummy, the readout read Last hit 45 / This burst 89 / Per second 89 / Last 5 s 89 / Total 89 against the sim meter, and Clear reset it to dealt 0 with dashes. Remove all and Place work, with feed lines. The heal label reads 'Full heal' while alive (panels.tsx:366 switches to 'Return to life' only when dead). At 1280x720 (_harness/_reports/integ2_client_ver1_pr720.json) the panel spans y 67-620 with no clipped text, the same whether armed or idle, and Esc disarms. NOT done: BRIDGE practice. Live, practice_bridge stayed loading for 121 s with the page error "rules: queue 'practice' belongs to mode 'rift', not 'bridge'" (shot _harness/_shots/integ2_client_ver1_practice_practice_bridge_02_loading_bridge_FAIL.png). regressions: Practice > Map > BRIDGE (new in this run: src/ui/screens/practice.tsx:25/:64 offers every two-team core mode) starts a match that never loads. Live: _harness/_reports/integ2_client_ver1_practice.json practice_bridge stayed on 'loading' for 121 s at 'BRIDGE · Practice' with the uncaught page error "rules: queue 'practice' belongs to mode 'rift', not 'bridge'" (shot _harness/_shots/integ2_client_ver1_practice_practice_bridge_02_loading_bridge_FAIL.png). The session stays in phase 'loading' with no host, so later queues are refused until a reload. The root cause is in systems (local_session.ts:409-413 keeps queue 'practice' of mode rift; :526 calls the bots factory outside the try), but the player can only reach this hang through the client lane's new Map choice. Fix: either systems lands the local_session fix, or client offers only the queue's own mode in the Map choice until it does.
